Definition
[two-positive curvature operator] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0094 1. ch11:11.1\group Positive Curvature Operators A Riemannian manifold has two-positive curvature operator if every sum of two distinct eigenvalues of its Riemann curvature operator is positive. Replacing ``positive'' by ``nonnegative'' defines a two-nonnegative curvature operator.
